name: chess_move_side
text: A person sits centred on a stool facing a chessboard, both feet planted. Use the LEFT hand to move a piece sideways across the near rank, from the left side towards the centre. Lift it before moving, set it down and return the left hand to the lap. The right hand rests on the right thigh. Keep hips supported on the stool, bend at the waist only as needed, and keep the inactive hand low on the thigh.
